edits.after:
cmp eax,32
    je pd_detach_returned
    cmp eax,0xfffffff7
    jne public_span_fail
    cmp qword ptr [rdx+56],0
    jne public_span_fail
    mov ecx,3

    mov rax,[r15+8]

    jz public_span_fail

direct_reply_result:
    cmp qword ptr [rbp+PD_STATE],3
    jne pd_reply_returned
    mov eax,0xfffffff7
    cmp [rbp+PN_P_DESCRIPTORS+48],rax
    jne public_span_fail
    cmp qword ptr [rbp+PN_P_DESCRIPTORS+56],0
    jne public_span_fail
    /* The actual destroyed future has no response frame. Its raw CANCELLED
     * return and full terminal state are retained in the fixed trace. */
    mov qword ptr [r13+DC_OUTPUT],0
    mov qword ptr [r13+DC_OUTPUT_LENGTH],0
    ret
pd_reply_returned:
    mov rax,[rbp+PN_P_DESCRIPTORS+48]
